clue.text: Actress's delight finding source of mint cake

definitions.note: read as 'Actress is', the clue's 's being a contraction of is

parts.note: felicity is great happiness or delight

explanation.walkthrough: KENDAL mint cake is a hard minty slab sold in the Lake District and carried by hikers; the town of Kendal is its home.
explanation.definitionFit: She is a well-known English stage and television performer, star of The Good Life.

clue.text: Small, delicate flower raised, attracting female

explanation.definitionFit: Elfin describes someone small and delicately built, like a fairy-tale elf.

clue.text: Con pound out of business when procuring rug

clue.text: Poison spread to this place — it's in the air

explanation.definitionFit: This ionised layer of the upper atmosphere lies high up in the sky, reflecting radio waves.

clue.text: Given period of time, husband at last agreed

parts.note: a year is a set or given span of time

explanation.walkthrough: 'at last' tells you to swap the last letter of YEAR, the R, for H.
explanation.definitionFit: Yeah is an informal yes, a word of assent said by someone who has agreed.

clue.text: Classical units unpopular in sorry English resort

out means out of favour or unpopular

clue.text: Type of market using borders of material in transaction

clue.text: She took photos ardently in ground, capturing amateur cricketers

clue.text: Female group monopolise painting in hall I'm moving for artist

parts.note: the WI is the Women's Institute, a British women's organisation

the letters of the hall phrase are moved around into a new order

art covers painting

explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges HALL I'M into LLIAMH; the inner pieces sit just before its final H. The WI is a British women's club.

clue.text: Geek displays this in European country, loudly occupying capital

clue.text: This writer welcomes jolly name for cartoon characters

clue.text: Remedy connection on the phone and finally contact America

clue.text: Signior regularly enters as food favoured by 8?

indicators.note: the chosen letters go into the Latin word for as

explanation.walkthrough: 8 is LINDA MCCARTNEY, a vegetarian who founded a meat-free food brand; the even letters of Signior are INO.

clue.text: Light alcohol with punch and power

to lam is to hit or punch
P is the physics abbreviation for power

clue.text: With skill, Daryl balances boxes leaning over

the two words box up, or contain, the letters needed

clue.text: Urban controller gets gutless offender, tagging boy one month

clue.text: 'Big Spender' might symbolise this record buyer?

definitions.text: 'Big Spender' might symbolise this record buyer?

parts.words: 'Big Spender' might symbolise this record buyer?
parts.note: the surface is about someone purchasing the record of the song Big Spender, but a big spender is also a compulsive buyer of goods in stores

clue.text: Male scientists must protect enclosure of trees which provide shelter

clue.text: Carpet area wearing excessively

parts.note: overly means too much, to excess

clue.text: Book footballer thumping one perhaps Cockney's saying

explanation.definitionFit: The Edda is an Old Norse book of Icelandic myths and poetry.

clue.text: Punk's outrageous probing topless bird
